name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.292.0 — init-gen policy-check names why risk tiers cannot be compared (no pipelineRules key, unreadable file, no § Risk Tiers) as one finding instead of one per tier with an empty filename; lib/host-config.js readPipelineRules is the one resolver/reader of the rules file for policy-check, decision-lint and both drivers. 7.291.0 — The commands read the policy block: /spec:run Step 0 honours worktreePerSpec, the Direct lane honours directLaneToMain, review MERGE honours mergeStrategy, CLOSE and doctor check 20 honour testExpiry, plan lock honours ledgerCommitted, the mocks driver's reviewService connect hint reads policy, and the build/review driver dispatch lines print the policy.models seats. 7.290.0 — The policy round at init: grounding contract gains an optional policy block (worktreePerSpec, directLaneToMain, mergeStrategy, testExpiry, ledgerCommitted, reviewService, models, riskTiers) with key-by-key defaults; /spec:init asks two policy rounds of four questions and writes the answers through init-gen generate, which validates the block and adds the run ledger to the ignore list when ledgerCommitted is false; generate --dry-run prints a permissions-and-files confirm before writing; init-gen policy-check and /spec:doctor check 24 report policy drift; the reviewer seat moves to fable at effort low.
